title: Ahengua a Ɛwɔ Akyirikyiri no Ho Ahintasɛm
intro: Ɔhene bi a ɔwɔ tumi, a wɔde tumi soronko ahyira no no hyiaa asɛnnennen soronko bi a ɛfa ɔhemmaa bi a ofi asase a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri ho. Ɔhene no hwehwɛɛ sɛ ɔbɛda ɔsoro tumi ne nyansa adi, na ɔde adeyɛ bi a ɛyɛ nwonwa a ɛne bere ne ahunmu mmara nhyia sii hɔ. So wubetumi ahu anwonwade a esii yi ho nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri?
clues: Wɔmaa sodifo tumi kɛse, a nea ɛka ho ne abɔde a wonhu wɔn so tumi ne tumi a otumi hyɛ mframa no.
Saa sodifo yi nsa kaa ɔhemmaa bi a ɔwɔ sika a ɔsom owia ho amanneɛbɔ, na osii gyinae sɛ ɔbɛto nsa afrɛ no aba ahemfie hɔ.
Ansa na ɔhemmaa no reba no, sodifo no daa ɔpɛ a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔde ne tumidi agua a ɛyɛ nwonwa no fi n’ahenni a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri no mu ba.
Jinn bi a ne ho yɛ den kae sɛ obegye ade no ansa na sodifo no asɔre afi n’agyinatukuw no mu.
Nanso, obi a ɔwɔ Ɔsoro Kyerɛwnsɛm no mu nimdeɛ a emu dɔ de gye a obegye no ntɛmntɛm mpo mae, na owiee adwuma no wɔ aniwa mu.
Bere a eduu hɔ no, sodifo no hyɛe sɛ wɔnsakra ade no mfa nsɔ ɔhemmaa no adwene ne n’adwene nhwɛ bere a awiei koraa no oduu ahemfie hɔ no.

verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
